question: What is the national dress of Japan?A. ChadorB. KiltC. SarongD. Kimono (RRB NTPC Tier I (06/04/2016) Shift 2)
options: A
B
C
D
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Kimono

Explanation:
The national dress of Japan is the Kimono, a traditional garment worn by both men and women. It is characterized by long sleeves, a T-shaped design, and is wrapped around the body and tied with a sash called an Obi. Kimonos are typically worn on special occasions such as weddings, festivals, and tea ceremonies. Option A 'Chador' is a traditional dress of Iran, Option B 'Kilt' is from Scotland, and Option C 'Sarong' is from Southeast Asia. Therefore, Kimono is the correct national dress of Japan.

question: Which of the following freedom fighters wrote the epic 'Kamala' on the prison walls?A. Madan Mohan MalviyaB. VD SavarkarC. SharatchandraD. Batukeshwar Dutt (RRB NTPC Tier I (06/04/2016) Shift 2)

solution:

Explanation:

'Kamala' is based on the valor of Indian heroines and is divided into seven cantos. Savarkar was sentenced to life imprisonment, but his writings contributed significantly to the freedom movement. The epic 'Kamala' reflects his poetic brilliance and patriotic fervor.

question_hi: निम्न में से कौन से स्वतंत्रता सेनानी ने जेल की दीवारों के भीतर महाकाव्य 'कमला' (kamala) लिखा था?A. मदन मोहन मालवीय B. वी.डी. सावरकर C. शरतचंद्र D. बटुकेश्वर दत्त        (RRB NTPC Tier I (06/04/2016) Shift 2)

Explanation:

question: Which country has won the maximum number of Oscar awards to date in the category of foreign films?A. ItalyB. FranceC. JapanD. Spain (RRB NTPC Tier I (07/04/2016) Shift 3)

question: What is the study of a map called?A. CalligraphyB. GeographyC. GeologyD. Cartography (RRB NTPC Tier I (07/04/2016) Shift 3)
options: Geology
Geography
Cartography
Calligraphy
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Cartography

Explanation:
The study, creation, and design of maps is called Cartography. It is both a science and an art that involves representing geographic data in map form. Calligraphy is the art of beautiful handwriting, Geography studies the Earth's surface, its physical properties, and human societies, while Geology deals with the solid Earth and its history. Cartography uses symbols, scales, and projections to present complex geographic information in a simple and understandable format.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:

☛ What is the importance of map scale? → It shows the ratio between ground and map distance

question: Which Indian state has decided to implement Bharat Net service that will connect all gram panchayats through optical fiber?A. MaharashtraB. PunjabC. Tamil NaduD. Uttar Pradesh (RRB NTPC Tier I (07/04/2016) Shift 3)

Explanation:

This initiative is part of the central government's ambitious Bharat Net project aimed at providing broadband connectivity to rural areas. Uttar Pradesh, being the largest state in India with the highest number of gram panchayats, stands to benefit significantly. The project aims to bridge the digital divide and improve access to e-governance, education, and healthcare services in rural regions. Implementing Bharat Net in Uttar Pradesh will connect millions of rural residents, enabling them to access high-speed internet and various digital services. question_hi: किस भारतीय राज्य ने भारत नेट सेवा लागू करने का फैसला किया है जो ऑप्टिकल फाइबर के माध्यम से सभी ग्राम पंचायतों को कनेक्ट करेगा ?A. महाराष्ट्रB. पंजाबC. तमिलनाडुD. उत्तर प्रदेश (RRB NTPC Tier I (07/04/2016) Shift 3)

question: What is the full form of the abbreviation RLWL in relation to trains?A. Regret Loss Waiting ListB. Remote Location Waiting ListC. Railway Location Waiting ListD. Railway List Waiting Locked (RRB NTPC Tier I (07/04/2016) Shift 3)
options: A
B
C
D
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Remote Location Waiting List

Explanation:
RLWL stands for Remote Location Waiting List. It is a special waiting list issued by Indian Railways for remote or less-connected stations. This list is typically applied to trains that pass through small or remote stations. The number of reservations under RLWL is limited, and the chances of confirmation are lower compared to the General Waiting List (GNWL). Passengers can apply for RLWL, but it may take longer to confirm. This system helps ensure that passengers from remote areas have a fair chance of booking tickets, though the probability of getting a confirmed berth is relatively low.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Full form of RLWL → Remote Location Waiting List
☛ For which stations RLWL is issued → Remote stations
☛ Full form of General Waiting List → GNWL
☛ Probability of confirmation in RLWL → Low
☛ Where RLWL is used → Indian Railways ticket reservation system
question_hi: रेलगाड़ियों के संबंध में संक्षिप्त नाम RLWL का पूरा नाम क्या है ?A. रिग्रेट लोस वेटिंग लिस्ट (Regret Loss Waiting List)B. रिमोट लोकेशन वेटिंग लिस्ट (Remote Location Waiting List)C. रेलवे लोकेशन वेटिंग लिस्ट (Railway Location Waiting List)D. रेलवे लिस्ट वेटिंग लोक्ड (Railway List Waiting Locked) (RRB NTPC Tier I (07/04/2016) Shift 3)
options_hi: A
B
C
D
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है रिमोट लोकेशन वेटिंग लिस्ट (Remote Location Waiting List)

Explanation:
RLWL का पूरा नाम Remote Location Waiting List है। यह भारतीय रेलवे द्वारा दूरस्थ या कम कनेक्टिविटी वाले स्टेशनों के लिए जारी की जाने वाली एक विशेष वेटिंग लिस्ट है। आमतौर पर, यह उन ट्रेनों में लागू होती है जो छोटे या दूरस्थ स्टेशनों से होकर गुजरती हैं। RLWL में आरक्षण की सीमित संख्या होती है और इसमें कन्फर्म होने की संभावना सामान्य वेटिंग लिस्ट (GNWL) की तुलना में कम होती है। यात्री RLWL के लिए आवेदन कर सकते हैं, लेकिन इसे कन्फर्म होने में अधिक समय लग सकता है।

question: Where is Indira Gandhi Memorial Tulip Garden?A. DarjeelingB. MysoreC. SrinagarD. Chandigarh (RRB NTPC Tier I (07/04/2016) Shift 3)

The garden is named after former Prime Minister Indira Gandhi. It is situated at the foothills of the Zabarwan mountain range and on the banks of Dal Lake. Every year, the Tulip Festival is held here, attracting tourists and showcasing a variety of colorful tulips.

question: What is the APGAR scale?A. Scale to measure the height of mountainsB. Time Measuring ScaleC. Scale to determine the physical condition of a newbornD. Longevity scale (RRB NTPC Tier I (12/04/2016) Shift 2)
options: C
A
B
D
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Scale to determine the physical condition of a newborn

Explanation:
APGAR scale is used to assess the physical condition of a newborn immediately after birth. It was developed by Dr. Virginia Apgar in 1952. The scale is based on five parameters: Appearance (skin color), Pulse (heart rate), Grimace (reflex response), Activity (muscle tone), and Respiration (breathing effort). Each parameter is scored 0, 1, or 2, giving a total score from 0 to 10. The test is performed at 1 minute and 5 minutes after birth. A high score indicates good health of the baby. This scale is not used for measuring mountain height, time, or longevity.
